# PromptPack

> PromptPack (promptpack.tech) is a digital shop run by Ornalens LLP, India. It sells editable AI prompt packs and illustrated PDF field guides for websites, personal finance, social media and video. 5 products have purchase routes, including 3 complete guide editions with free sample prompts.

Updated: 2026-10-28. All products are digital downloads used with the buyer's own AI tools. They do not include AI credits, software subscriptions, recorded courses or publishing services.

## Available now

- [Money Audit Pack](https://promptpack.tech/finance): Find recurring charges in your billing emails. Turn them into a Keep / Review / Compare / Negotiate action plan with your AI assistant. Gmail setup + audit prompts + review worksheets. US$19, or ₹1,599 · one time.
- [75+ 3D Website Prompts](https://promptpack.tech/products/website-prompts/): Create 3D-style websites, landing pages, portfolios and SaaS with editable prompts and motion references. Pick a design, customize the brief and build in your AI tool. 75+ Markdown prompts + motion references. US$8.50, one-time purchase.

## Complete digital guide editions

- [Carousel Studio](https://promptpack.tech/products/carousel-studio/): Design six-slide carousels with a cover that earns the swipe, then plan, approve and publish them. 29-page guide, 28 prompts, starter files. Available for US$15 (international cards) or ₹899 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets), paid once through Razorpay. Free sample prompt on the page.
- [UGC Ad Script Kit](https://promptpack.tech/products/ugc-ad-scripts/): Turn an honest product demonstration into a visually directed short ad. 14-page guide, 22 prompts, starter files. Available for US$12 (international cards) or ₹699 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets), paid once through Razorpay. Free sample prompt on the page.
- [Juno & Pixel](https://promptpack.tech/products/motion-with-code/): Two-character 3D reels from a 100-word script, made entirely in code. 16-page guide, 20 prompts, starter files. Available for US$29 (international cards) or ₹1,499 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets), paid once through Razorpay. Free sample prompt on the page.

## Small-business toolkits
- [BakePrice Studio](https://promptpack.tech/products/bakeprice-studio/): An offline recipe-costing and quote tool for home bakers. Include whole batches, ingredient costs, labour and packaging before choosing your selling price. USD 12 or INR 699, one-time purchase. A laptop or desktop with a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari browser. Unzip the files and open START.html. No account, spreadsheet app or internet connection is required for the tool. Save JSON backups; browser storage may be cleared or unavailable.
- [Salon Content Sprint](https://promptpack.tech/products/salon-content-sprint/): Thirty salon content slots with English and Roman-script Hinglish captions, twelve reel plans, eight carousel scripts and an offline editing planner. USD 9 or INR 499, one-time purchase. A laptop or desktop browser for the offline planner, your own salon facts and rights-cleared photos or footage. No AI subscription is required to use the supplied copy. Filming, design, posting and client approval are your responsibility. Back up your edits as JSON.
